summary: Southland Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a September 30, 2026 First Amendment to its previously disclosed Financial Assistance Agreement with its surety group (Berkshire Hathaway Specialty Insurance, Zurich American, Hartford, Euler Hermes, Markel, Western Surety, Federal Insurance), with Berkshire Hathaway Specialty Insurance as collateral agent. The amendment extends the deadline for issuing senior non-voting preferred shares—converting certain Non-Bonding Financing—from September 30, 2026 to no later than November 13, 2026. No price, stake, premium or board recommendation is stated; the full amendment will be filed as an exhibit. Watch conversion timing and dilution from preferred issuance.
